name: Handball 2
desc:
⚽ Welcome to Handball, a fast-paced team sports game on Roblox! Similar to soccer, but played with your hands. Team up, score goals, and win matches.

❗ Latest Update ❗
• Play as 12 NEW exciting teams
• New mechanics
• Various bug fixes for a smoother gameplay experience

🏆 Compete in fast-paced team matches
🎨 Customize your experience with unique cosmetics
📈 Increase your OVR and become an elite player
🌎 Easy to learn, fun to master

💠 Tips to Improve 💠
• Aim higher than you think you need to
• Jump to recover from diving
• Teamwork is key, always look for open teammates

🖥️ Play on Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet!
